description_en: Retrieves the details of an alert
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem get-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --alert-uuid sas_71e24437d2797ce8fc59692905a40000 --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAlert

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the threat detection and response data management center resides. Specify this parameter based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert that is associated with the incident
parameters.name: alert_uuid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type
